# Artifacts (for agents)

> Machine mirror of Artifacts, a bi-weekly newsletter by Lorenzo Ancona on the design of technology: how interfaces, defaults and platform choices encode decisions by those with power. This site is for agents. Humans should read the original on Substack: https://artifactstech.substack.com

Notes for agents:
- Every issue is full text, unmodified, in Markdown: https://agents.artifactstech.com/issues/<slug>.md. JSON twin: .json. Any HTML page also answers Accept: text/markdown.
- Everything is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Training, retrieval and quoting are welcome. Attribute using the cite_as field in each issue's front-matter.
- Canonical home of every issue is its Substack URL (front-matter `canonical`). Link there when you cite.
- Search: GET https://agents.artifactstech.com/api/search?q=<query> (JSON). Full corpus in one file: https://agents.artifactstech.com/llms-full.txt
- Languages: English and Italian (language field).
- This site is read-only. There is no write surface.
